description: Rank tracked entities (servers, agents, models) by a project-level metric — project_momentum (score: middle of star/download/HF-derivative growth ranks) or trend_days (days on GitHub Trending) over the 7d window; limit/offset page through the full ranked list. Numbers and catalog facts only, no quality scores. Read-only aggregation of daily-collected observatory data; no side effects. Package download days may be missing (npm/PyPI reporting delay); missing days are null with notes, never fake zeros. Use when the user asks what is rising; for the daily GitHub Trending list use `get_github_trending`.
name: get_leaderboard
title: Get Leaderboard
